attacks.name: Hip Fire
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

|*Rapid Fire|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make one additional |*Hip Fire| attack. The additional attack must target the original defender. The additional attack does not have the |*Rapid Fire| special rule.

attacks.name: Aimed Shot
steps: |!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.
After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| and |§slow§Slow| special conditions.

superPowers.name: No More Second Chances
superPowers.body: Remove up to 3 |<punishment>Punishment| tokens from this character. During the next attack made by this character this Turn, add 1 die to its attack roll for each |<punishment>Punishment| token removed. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Spec Ops Training
superPowers.body: Advance this character |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Warzone
superPowers.body: |*Action|: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 3 or less within |!range| 4. Enemy characters within |!range| 1 of the terrain feature suffer 2 |!damage|. Then the chosen terrain feature is destroyed and removed from the battlefield. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: The Fallen
superPowers.body: When another allied character is Dazed or KO'd by an enemy effect, after the effect is resolved, this character gains a |<punishment>Punishment| token. This character can have a maximum of 3 Punishment tokens at any time.
